name: presto-prod-wcag-audit
description: WCAG 2.2 AA audit of the production EventPipe/Presto booking journey. Captures real production HTML+CSS and documents every violation with a ready-to-ship fix.

scripts.pipeline: pnpm capture && pnpm audit && pnpm analyze && pnpm tokens && pnpm foundations && pnpm report
scripts.a11y:ci: concurrently -k -s first -n SB,A11Y "http-server storybook-static -p 6006 -a 127.0.0.1 -s" "wait-on -t 60000 tcp:127.0.0.1:6006 && pnpm test-storybook"
